items.question: What are Frieda Buhner's stats?
items.answer: In the 2026 regular season, Frieda Buhner averaged 6.3 points, 2.1 rebounds, and 0.7 assists in 39 games for the Portland Fire.

items.question: When was Frieda Buhner drafted?
items.answer: The Portland Fire selected Frieda Buhner (Bühner) in the second round, 17th overall, in the 2026 WNBA Draft. She played in 39 regular-season games as a rookie and scored a career-high 16 points at Las Vegas on July 28.
